FEAT-6-S24.title: Consent Data Schema and Contracts
FEAT-6-S24.description: Define and implement Pydantic models and data contracts for consent capture, including Tier 1 vs Tier 2 flags, timestamping, user identifiers (if allowed), and storage directives for downstream services.

FEAT-6-S25.title: Consent Integration with Lead Capture and Unknowns
FEAT-6-S25.description: Integrate ConsentService with LeadService and UnknownQuestionService to ensure all stored data respects consent tier rules, including blocking identified storage when only Tier 1 consent is granted.

FEAT-6-S26.title: Consent Audit Logging and Persistence
FEAT-6-S26.description: Implement persistence of consent decisions and audit logs, ensuring all consent changes, tier upgrades, and data handling actions are recorded for compliance and traceability.
